segments.name: Consumer Banking
segments.description: Digital wallet and banking services for consumers: payments, cards, loans, investments and insurance distribution on the PicPay platform.
segments.evidence: Consumer Banking: generates revenue from various transaction activities occurring in the digital wallet, such as Pix, peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers, and bill payments, including when customers use credit cards as a funding source for payments or money transfers, either in one or multiple installments.

segments.name: Small and Medium-Sized Businesses
segments.description: Payment acceptance and corporate benefits services for merchants and companies using the PicPay network.
segments.evidence: Small and Medium-Sized Businesses: generates revenues from MDR (merchant-discount rates) charged to merchants accepting PicPay as a payment network.

segments.name: Audiences and Ecosystem Integration
segments.description: Advertising and marketplace services sold to brands, merchants and consumers inside the PicPay app ecosystem.
segments.evidence: Audiences and Ecosystem Integration: This segment provides services to all of the Group's customers, which include consumers and businesses, with the goal of increasing engagement and monetization of both sides of the ecosystem.

segments.name: Institutional
segments.description: Corporate-level funding, liquidity and financial investment activities that support all other segments of the group.
segments.evidence: Institutional: This segment encompasses revenues, costs and expenses from financial investments and funding activities executed at the Corporate level.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and merchants pay fees on payments, cards and credit, plus commissions on products distributed through the PicPay platform.
revenueModel.evidence: TPV represents the total amount of payments that pass through our ecosystem, and we generate revenue from certain payment transactions as a percentage of TPV.
